fragility: Value-field shapes are schema-pinned (tool-bash output oneOf); rendered markers are wording-sensitive. Cross-tree drift is caught by grepping the upstream construction points (tool-bash/src/render.ts:53,77-83,106-117; tool-bash-persistent/src/index.ts:21,355; packages/core/tools/src/abort-utils.ts:116-124) at harness-bump time. Value triggers: 'promoted'/'foreground' match the success value's kind; sandboxDenied matches value.sandbox.denied === true. Outcome 'error-or-nonzero-exit' = isError OR a success value {kind:'foreground', exitCode:number !== 0} (null exitCode does NOT match).

classes.guidance: The command may have partially applied before timing out (or still runs as a background job). Verify the intended postcondition (e.g. re-check files/processes, read job state) before re-running it.
Sandbox denial: a file effect was refused mid-run (partial effects possible) or the runner itself failed (nothing ran). Check the result marker; verify state before re-running with wider permissions.
Git mutations are not atomic with respect to retries. Run a read-only `git status`/`git log` check first.
Package installs mutate node_modules progressively. Check `node_modules`/lockfile state before re-running; a partial install is usually resumable.
If this call mutated remote state, verify before retrying; read-only calls can be retried freely.
The write may be partial. Read the target path before retrying.
